deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 16% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.8% = 10-year Treasury 4.8% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 25% last year; 23%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: Not meaningful (the company holds more cash than its debt plus equity, or data is missing); return on shareholders' equity 2% (3 years ago -27%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $1.5B, up 91% from a year ago — about 0.5× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $448M, up 45% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Stock-based pay is 20% of sales — a real cost to shareholders that cash-flow figures leave out.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 23%/yr over 3 years and 32%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today -1% vs a 5-year range of -35–-1% (median -15%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
deeper.margin_position: near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $406M to shareholders over the last 12 months ($406M buybacks + $0M dividends) = 1.6% of the company's market value. Share count up 1.1% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $7.90, up 8% in 90 days (up 1% in the last 30); 13 analysts raised, 2 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $6.56, up 7% in 90 days; 2 analysts raised, 1 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By product, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Subscription 97% of sales, up 31%; Services 3% of sales, up 29%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +90% vs a year ago · $0.72 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 90% vs sales 30%: profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running, but the beats are shrinking (66% → 27%): the bar is getting harder to clear.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 30% from a year ago and speeding up (from 27% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Operating margin -1%: it spends more to run the business than it earns from sales.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 1119% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 428× last year's profit; only 40× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Dec 1; analysts expect EPS of $1.61, up 22% from a year ago. It usually moves about 19% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
tiles.read: Next year's EPS forecast is up 8% in 90 days (13 raised, 2 cut lately): forecasts are edging up.
tiles.explain: How the average analyst forecast for next year's earnings per share changed (Yahoo, unofficial).
